legenda_completa: Thirteen years. Three console generations. One city. 🥹 This farewell montage runs through Grand Theft Auto V’s entire run in Los Santos: the skyline at sunrise and sunset, the Vinewood sign, the Del Perro pier, and Michael, Franklin and Trevor, closing on the three of them standing over the water at sunset. The run it is saying goodbye to lasted 13 years and three console generations. Grand Theft Auto V launched on September 17, 2013 for PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360, was re-released on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One in 2014 and on PC in 2015, and came to PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S in 2022.
